title: NERV export format and mapping into FPVBuddy
goal: The file FPVBuddy accepts from NERV's one-time export is defined and validated
acceptance: A versioned format (documented, with a validator) covers batteries with resistance readings, cycles and notes, fleet and parts, drone models, spares, crashes with their battery-damage links, and builds and manufacturer docs if F-015-T01 keeps them; photos are carried as NERV photo ids mapped to FPVBuddy ids, or moved as files, as the record names; an invented fixture covers every table
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
Owner data, export files and ID maps never enter Git

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: NERV's tables are known from F-010's inventory; the photo choice carries the uncertainty. Not a measurement.
